anchor.statement: Lemma 10.2. For every spatial multi-index α and integer j ≥ 0, ∂ α x ∂ j t f converges uniformly on R3 as t ↑ 1. There are functions F j ∈ C ∞ c ( R3 ; R3 ), all supported in K, such that lim t↑1 ∂ α x ∂ j t f(x, t) = ∂ α x F j (x), ∂ α x F j (0) = 0. (10.6) These are the derivative limits of f from t < 1, compatible under spatial and time differentiation.

correspondence.note: Stated for the residual of the lattice-periodized, time-activated fields rather than the compactly supported f of (10.5), and conditional on vanishing jets of the original residual at (0, 1) and smooth one-sided extensions of the potential and pressure away from the origin. The convergence is locally uniform rather than uniform on R³, and the limits are periodic, so F_j ∈ C_c^∞ with support in K is not stated; smoothness, compatibility and vanishing at the origin of the limits are stated.

HasFDerivWithinAt
  (fun (y : NavierStokes.SpacetimeEndpoint.SpaceTime) =>
    NavierStokes.SpacetimeEndpoint.extendJets 1
      (ftaylorSeries ℝ (NavierStokes.PeriodicResidualLimits.periodicResidual A p))
      (NavierStokes.PeriodicResidualLimits.boundaryLimits A p eA ep) y n)
  (NavierStokes.SpacetimeEndpoint.extendJets 1
      (ftaylorSeries ℝ (NavierStokes.PeriodicResidualLimits.periodicResidual A p))
      (NavierStokes.PeriodicResidualLimits.boundaryLimits A p eA ep) z (n + 1)).curryLeft
  (NavierStokes.SpacetimeEndpoint.closedPast 1) z
